sufficiency_witness: 2017 sediments were washed on a 150 µm mesh, so taxa whose adults are 63–150 µm could not be retained; their zeros in 2017 are not absences. Diversity is comparable only on the >150 µm taxa, a restriction the answer must state; stopping with the reason is also acceptable.
analysis_specification: If the campaigns used different sieve meshes, restrict both campaigns to taxa whose adult_test_size is '>150 µm' when the coarser mesh is 150 µm. Compute Shannon (natural log) per core on the retained taxa and report the mean per campaign.
